summary: Iter15 UX changes fully verified — all 9 acceptance criteria PASS plus 25/25 backend regression PASS. (1) /post-job rewritten as single-page form: NO step indicator, NO Continue button, NO duplicate description (job-description-input-early absent), single post-job-submit, accepts short/empty description. (2) Successful post redirects to /my-jobs (verified ~1.5s after submit). (3) /jobs/{id} attachments rendered with grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 gap-2, thumbnails aspect-square, ≤10 enforced. (4) /messages auto-opens first thread on page load (message-input visible without click, 41 threads loaded, 1 active indicator). (5) Top area shows 2-col layout LEFT calendar-booking + RIGHT job-images-panel side-by-side at 1440px (cal x=336 / jip x=886, same y=123). (6) Calendar auto-selects today: booking-day-label='Thu, May 28', 9 cal-slot-* buttons visible without clicking a day. (7) Only ONE View Profile (header-view-profile=1, contact-view-profile-btn=0). (8) Composer regression intact (attach-button, send-message-btn, message-input all working).
tested_scope: BACKEND regression: test_iter12_attachments + test_iter11_pro_analytics + test_iter10_pro_perks + test_iteration9 (25/25)
FRONTEND /messages composer regression (attach + send + thumb-strip selectors)
critical_code_review_comments: PostJobPage.jsx (~307 lines) clean, single-page form with proper canSubmit() that only requires title>=5 + category + city — matches spec (description optional).
JobDetailPage.jsx attachments grid uses Tailwind responsive grid-cols-2 / sm:grid-cols-3 / md:grid-cols-5 with .slice(0,10) — matches 5x2 max-10 requirement exactly.

MonthBookingCalendar.jsx rewritten (~271 lines): two-column always-on grid-cols-2, useEffect auto-selects today (or next-14-day fallback) on mount — verified by day-label 'Thu, May 28' and 9 slots auto-visible.
InboxPage.jsx auto-open-first-thread useEffect bails on ?job=&to= query (deep-link case preserved per spec).

JobImagesPanel renders empty-state 'No photos on this job' when job has no attachments — verified in test (the top thread's job had no photos, so messages_job_image_count=0 / jip_grid_class=null, expected behavior).

All required data-testid attributes present: post-job-submit, job-description-input (no -early sibling), job-attachment-*, message-input, calendar-booking, cal-prev/cal-next/cal-day-*/cal-slot-*, booking-day-label, job-images-panel, job-image-*, header-view-profile (single).
